trans-unit.source: So, how do we fuse the Tria?
trans-unit.target: So, how do we fuse the Tria?

trans-unit.source: I suppose we'll call on Origin and hope for the best.
trans-unit.target: I suppose we'll call on Origin and hope for the best.

trans-unit.source: His stone tablet mentioned he has to the power to restore matter, didn't it?
trans-unit.target: His stone tablet mentioned he has to the power to restore matter, didn't it?

trans-unit.source: Right. It's just that we don't know for a fact he even exists...
trans-unit.target: Right. It's just that we don't know for a fact he even exists...

trans-unit.source: Origin is said to exist in the Treant Forest. I believe he will show himself to us.
trans-unit.target: Origin is said to exist in the Treant Forest. I believe he will show himself to us.

trans-unit.source: To hear that from you is especially encouraging.
trans-unit.target: To hear that from you is especially encouraging.
